market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-volatile. CPI report is the pivotal catalyst: hot print triggers Fed hike, further yield spike, and equity selloff. Oil above $100 sustains inflation pressure. 4-day S&P slide suggests momentum shift. Treasury $6B buyback signals fiscal anxiety. Expect 5-8% equity volatility into CPI. Bond yields likely to test new multiyear highs.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive if oil stabilizes below $95 and Fed pauses. AI infrastructure buildout (nuclear energy, data centers) supports 12-month tech earnings. India and Nigeria offer EM diversification. Trade war with Canada adds 6-12 month headwind to North American manufacturing. Sports/media consolidation creates M&A opportunities. Apple foldable could restart hardware cycle.
